portable_guards: Use exact known skill paths and bounded reads.
Use the exact committed validator and manifest contract files.
Use rg include globs with -g instead of wildcard path arguments.
Enumerate the exact phase Method Flow directory before parsing its terminal ledger.
Read prior_proposals and new_proposals from the exact frozen-chain schema.
Retain the rejected candidates and freeze only mechanism-distinct replacements.
Split exact Git state from bounded rg file inventories.
Invoke quick_validate.py only with an exact initialized skill directory.
Enumerate the exact requests directory before reading witnesses.
Preserve all 1,360 inherited rows byte-for-byte, bind novelty to row title and reported nearest identifier, and disclose the historical identifier multiplicity without rewriting history.

Align noncontroversial baton and storage fields, preserve the runner's remaining new-task policy mismatch as needs_refinement, and bind the live activation separately without claiming the older tool validated task creation.
Read exact current lines and apply smaller reviewed hunks; grant no credit to the rejected patch.
Keep the observed version output but reduce command labels to executable basenames and public argument labels.
Run staged validation fail-fast after isolating the first sanitized finding, and do not chain later lifecycle steps behind a failing validator.
Measure short descriptions before invoking init_skill and keep them within 25 to 64 characters.
Historical freeze assertions must read their immutable commit or tree rather than a later working tree.
Use one bounded repository-state query and direct known-file reads instead of combining enumeration and content search.
Do not enumerate a large generated untracked packet through ordinary Git status before staging.
Discover generated portfolio filenames from the bounded phase root instead of guessing their location.
Use an explicit collection variable when piping the results of a Windows PowerShell foreach statement.
Test directly executable repository scripts with their containing scripts directory explicitly bound on sys.path.
Resolve workflow evidence from the frozen packet inventory rather than inventing a convenience filename.
Keep credential prefixes boundary-aware and maintain an exact scanner-definition allowlist without suppressing ordinary payload files.
Inspect generated receipt keys before adding downstream validator bindings.
Do not combine staging, repeated manifest generation, and diff hygiene in one long wrapper.
Never pass manifest content through text strip, newline conversion, or decode-encode cycles before hashing.
Bind route assertions to the explicit lifecycle artifact rather than one timeless label.
Inspect exact target context before composing a large multi-file patch.
Read the active runner help or a current successful invocation before composing summary flags.
Enumerate exact compatibility-update paths in the final staged allowlist before review.
Do not combine unrelated target files in a patch when their context labels can be confused.
